hero_h.text_004: For band, orchestra, choir, theatre and private studios
hero_h.text_006: Fees, families, instruments, music, seating and messages, built by a band director who still runs his own program on it.
hero_h.text_010: Every screen works in light and dark mode.

built.text_013: Built by a director who uses it every day.
built.text_014: I've taught band and choir, music directed school and community theatre productions, taught at the college level, and run a private studio. Every one of those roles came with the same second job: fees and balances, forms, inventory, the music library, messages home, schedules. Program Partner started as one place to keep my own program organized. When other directors saw it, they asked if they could use it.

problem.text_018: You didn't start teaching to chase fee envelopes, permission slips, missing instruments, trip deposits or unread group texts.
problem.text_019: You didn't start teaching to chase
problem.text_025: Balances live in one spreadsheet, the instrument list in another, permission slips in a folder, and reminders in a group text nobody reads. Program Partner gives your staff, boosters and families one shared program office, so the questions stop landing in your inbox.

woodshed.text_026: Woodshed: free practice for band, orchestra and choir students.
woodshed.text_027: Students practice fingerings, rhythm counting, solfège and lyrics for free, with no sign-in. Practice you assign from Program Partner reports back next to their Skill Pathways and practice logs.

inside.text_030: And every standard tool a program office needs.
inside.text_031: Fees, rosters, forms, trips, inventory and the music library come with it, so you don't need a second system for the basics.
inside.text_033: Balances, online payments into your own account, ledgers and budgets.
inside.text_035: One roster, with portals for parents and students.
inside.text_036: Announcements, messages and one shared calendar.
inside.text_038: Fillable PDF forms, signatures and reminders.
inside.text_040: Who has paid, signed and registered for every event.
inside.text_042: Every instrument and uniform, checked out and accounted for.
inside.text_044: Scores and parts, with optional digital parts and recordings.
inside.text_046: Class seating and concert charts that combine groups.
inside.text_048: Skill Pathways, practice logs, attendance and more.

money.text_053: Families pay from their portal. Venmo works through PayPal.
money.text_055: The money goes straight into your program's own account.
money.text_057: No one has to post the payment by hand.
money.text_059: Program Partner charges no payment fees and never holds your funds. Your processor's standard rates still apply.

families.text_060: Parents and students both see what's owed.
families.text_061: Every family gets a portal with balances, forms and announcements. Students can sign in and see their own balance too, so nobody has to ask how much is still owed.

start.text_065: Schedule a demo and we'll walk through it with you, using the demo school and your own questions. When you're ready, we'll set you up, and we can move your spreadsheets in for you.
start.text_066: Bring your messiest spreadsheet. We'll show you where it goes.
